focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期数据申报常见问题指南，强调进口商须确保申报数据可核查。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳成本传导压力，建议尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，与欧盟进口商协同完成数据申报，并关注CBAM覆盖范围可能扩大的立法动态。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会税收与海关总署 · 2026.10.27
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's CBAM transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with definitive carbon levies applying from 2027. The European Commission recently issued FAQs on transitional data reporting, stressing that importers must ensure verifiable data. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium and fertilisers face carbon cost pass-through pressure. Companies should establish product-level carbon footprint accounting, coordinate with EU importers on data reporting, and monitor legislative developments that may expand CBAM's scope.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心案例：跨境供货合同不可抗力条款解释趋严，通知义务成关键
case.summary: 近期新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）公布的一起仲裁裁决显示，仲裁庭对不可抗力条款的解释趋于严格，强调援引方须在合同约定期限内发出具体、充分的不可抗力通知，并证明事件与履约障碍之间的因果关系。该案涉及中国供应商与东南亚买方之间的设备供货合同，因供应链中断引发争议。仲裁庭认为，笼统援引政府政策而未提供实质证据的通知不构成有效通知。建议出海企业在合同中明确通知时限与证据要求，并建立应急通知流程。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心案例摘要 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: SIAC Tribunal Takes Stricter Approach to Force Majeure Clauses: Notification Obligations Prove Decisive
case.summary_en: A recently published SIAC award reveals a stricter interpretive approach to force majeure clauses, emphasising that the invoking party must issue a specific and substantiated notice within the contractual time limit and demonstrate causation between the event and the impediment. The case involved an equipment supply contract between a Chinese supplier and a Southeast Asian buyer, with disputes arising from supply chain disruptions. The tribunal held that a generic reference to government policy without substantive evidence did not constitute valid notice. Exporters should specify notice deadlines and evidentiary requirements in contracts and establish emergency notification protocols.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化再提速，涉外企业数据出境合规路径更趋清晰
policy.summary: 近期粤港澳大湾区在跨境数据流动领域持续推出便利化措施，包括扩展安全评估、标准合同备案和个人信息保护认证的适用场景，并探索“白名单”机制。国家网信办与广东省相关部门协同推进大湾区数据跨境流动合作，为区内企业提供更明确的合规指引。建议涉及跨境业务的企业梳理数据出境场景，优先利用大湾区试点政策完成合规路径选择，并关注行业主管部门发布的细则。
policy.source: 来源：国家互联网信息办公室、广东省相关主管部门 · 2026年10月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Accelerates Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation, Clarifying Compliance Pathways for Foreign-Related Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has continued to roll out facilitation measures for cross-border data flows, including expanding the application scenarios for security assessments, standard contract filing and personal information protection certification, and exploring a 'whitelist' mechanism. The Cyberspace Administration of China and Guangdong authorities are jointly advancing GBA data cross-border cooperation to provide clearer compliance guidance. Enterprises with cross-border operations should map their data export scenarios, prioritise GBA pilot policies when selecting compliance pathways, and monitor detailed rules issued by sector regulators.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of China; Guangdong Authorities · October 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美欧供应链尽职调查规则叠加，中企须构建可追溯合规证据链
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国《维吾尔强迫劳动预防法》与欧盟《企业可持续发展尽职调查指令》相继实施，形成供应链合规双重压力。企业仅作书面承诺已不足够，须建立覆盖原材料采购、生产加工、物流运输的可追溯证据链，并保留第三方审计记录。建议出海企业将尽职调查嵌入采购合同，要求供应商提供可验证的溯源信息，同时关注欧盟指令转化为成员国法律的时限差异，提前开展供应链映射与风险分级，避免因单点断供引发连锁违约。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.10.27
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Overlapping US-EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Rules Require Chinese Firms to Build Traceable Compliance Evidence Chains
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The implementation of the US Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act and the EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive has created dual compliance pressure on supply chains. Written commitments alone are no longer sufficient; companies must establish traceable evidence chains covering raw material sourcing, production and logistics, and retain third-party audit records. Exporters should embed due diligence into procurement contracts, require suppliers to provide verifiable traceability information, and monitor differences in member state transposition deadlines. Supply chain mapping and risk tiering should be conducted in advance to avoid cascading defaults from single-point disruptions.
